name: describe_prefab
summary: What a buildable prefab is before it stands anywhere, in its own frame: placement kind, the turns it takes, its cells, render box, ports, visual top and controls side. Read only.

help.text: Its own frame is unturned, x right, y up, z forward, origin snapped as the cursor snaps it. Returns prefab_name, prefab_hash, display_name, build_states, runtime_type, placement (grid, face or face_mount), grid_size_m, small_grid, rotation_axes, allowed_rotations [{facing, up, euler}], small_cell_count (small_cells, the offsets themselves, only with include_small_cells; grid_box is their box), render_box, grid_box, ports [{index, type, role, flow, at, outward}], visual_up, reversible_flow, has_cursor, controls and, for a rocket engine, engine (topic engine).
help.keys: prefab_name, prefab_hash, display_name, build_states, runtime_type, placement, grid_size_m, small_grid, rotation_axes, allowed_rotations [{facing, up, euler}], small_cell_count, small_cells [{x, y, z}], render_box {min, max, size}, grid_box {min, max, size}, ports [{index, type, role, flow, at, outward}], visual_up {local, lying_allowed, source, verified}, reversible_flow {logic_type, value, reason}, has_cursor, controls {local, votes, considered, source, fallback}, engine {name, max_thrust_n, feed, inputs, ...}.

engine.summary: A rocket engine's load-time thrust and its feed.
engine.text: engine {name, max_thrust_n (its thrust on its own test fuel at full throttle, as the game fills it at load), max_exhaust_velocity_ms, specific_impulse_s, max_fuel_flow_rate (what that test burn drew in a tick), efficiency (25 is 100 %) and efficiency_percent, mass_kg, chamber_volume_l, feed (pumped_gas, pressure_fed_gas, pumped_liquid or pressure_fed_liquid), inputs [{input, role, pipe, pipe_max_kpa}], and the feed's limits: max_moles_per_tick (pumped gas), litres_per_tick (pumped liquid), max_pressure_per_tick_kpa and flow_rate_min_l/max_l (pressure fed)}. rocket_forecast flies a design with real fuel.

visual_up.text: visual_up {local (the axis that reads as its top), lying_allowed, source, verified (true when seen live or forced by the game; false: a guess, or source ASSUMED for a prefab that builds any way up)}. controls {local (the axis its slots, buttons and switches face), votes, considered, source, fallback (true: no control sits clearly on one side, so forward +z stands in)}, left out for anything with no controls. reversible_flow: turbo volume pumps, whose Mode 0 and 1 move gas opposite ways.

include_small_cells.description: Default false. true: list small_cells, each cell's offset; grid_box and small_cell_count are always given.

prefab.description: Prefab name (StructureWallLight, as find_things and looking_at report them) or prefab hash.
